source.name: TGSRTC Buses GTFS (Open Data Telangana, public domain)
source.selection: Most-used stop pattern per route and direction with >= 30 trips/day, >= 90% of stops inside the metro area and at least one stop within 400 m of a metro station. Stop order and first-stop departure times are from the feed.
source.modelled: Bus distance = straight line between stops x 1.3 (road detour). Run time = distance at 12 km/h, because the feed's intermediate stop times are interpolated and unrealistic.
